claims: WrestleMania 42 was held in Allegiant Stadium.
Brock Lesnar lost to Oba Femi at WrestleMania 42.
Brock Lesnar's match against Oba Femi lasted 4:42.
Brock Lesnar left his gloves and boots in the center of the ring after his loss.
Brock Lesnar returned for a part-time role in 2021.
The April 19, 2026 events at WrestleMania 42 are being widely reported as Brock Lesnar's retirement moment
